title: What AION 2 is and how global differs from KR/TW
text: what aion 2 is and how global differs from kr/tw aion 2 is ncsoft's ue5 sequel to aion, already live in korea/taiwan since a rocky launch in nov 2025. what it is aion 2 is ncsoft's unreal engine 5 sequel and remake of the original aion. it keeps the elyos vs asmodian conflict and the same eight classes. marketing describes a playable world roughly 36 times larger than the original, with flight restrictions removed. unverified spot-check 2026-09-12: the cited lagofast page does not contain this comparison; treat the size figure as marketing folklore until an official source states it. korea and taiwan launched first korea and taiwan launched on november 19, 2025 nc.com, 2025-111 mmorpg.com, kr-era2. kr-era that launch was rocky, and ncsoft had to scramble: 40 servers went live with congestion and a character-name registration bug, forcing emergency maintenance. within about 15 hours, ncsoft apologized for cash-shop bundles that included gear-enhancement items it had previously promised would not be sold for real money. nc pulled the bundles, gave the enhancement items free to everyone, zeroed skill-reset costs, and halved cash-shop consumable prices. ncsoft's stock reportedly dropped about 15% in a single day massivelyop.com, 2025-113 aion2.online, date unknown4 vpesports.com, date unknown5. despite the backlash, aion 2 reportedly earned about $70 million in its first six weeks in korea and taiwan. single source escapistmagazine.com, date unknown6 unclear: the exact global level cap. kr/tw raised its cap from 45 to 50 around july 2026, but global may launch with active-skill and stigma caps at "level 20" while the character cap could still be 45. nc has not clarified which numbers apply globally. single source, lower-trust mmoexp.com, date unknown7 background: mmoculture.com, 2026-078, ldcloud.net, date unknown9 overview global kr tw comparison unreal engine

title: Faction and server choice
text: faction and server choice faction and server choice is permanent, faction-locked, and mostly cosmetic, so pick where your friends are. what it is faction and server choice is a single, largely permanent decision. elyos and asmodians sit on faction-exclusive servers, and you generally only meet the other faction in instanced content, abyss battles, or specific events. there is currently no stated way to switch factions later. guildorder.com, date unknown1 mein-mmo.de, 2026-092 lootwow.com, date unknown3 both factions share the same 8 classes and the same faction-war endgame; there is no evidence of a power difference between them, so the choice is cosmetic and social rather than a power tier. elyos start in poeta (western, light-aligned, capital sanctum); asmodians occupy the eastern/dark-aligned side. beginner tip: because legions (guilds) are faction-locked, picking the same faction and server as friends matters far more here than in games where players can freely mix. classes classes (8 total), trinity-organized: tank, templar; melee dps, gladiator and assassin; ranged physical dps, ranger; magic dps, sorcerer and spiritmaster; healer, cleric; hybrid support, chanter. single source, lower-trust mmoexp.com, date unknown4 also see: aion2wiki.com, date unknown5, exitlag.com, date unknown6, timesaver.gg, date unknown7 faction server elyos asmodian legion guild choice permanent

title: Free to play, with an asterisk
text: free to play, with an asterisk global needs no subscription to play, but a $15/month membership gates the player-driven economy. global is free to play with no subscription required to play, but an optional $15/month membership unlocks: the player market the kinah/quna currency exchange face-to-face trading without membership, players are reportedly locked out of most of the player-driven economy. there is also a per-character premium daeva pass, a cosmetics/consumables cash shop, and the founder's packs. two currencies exist: kinah (earned in-game) and quna (premium, also exchangeable for kinah). mmorpg.com, 2026-071 massivelyop.com, 2026-072 why it matters: this "sell access to the economy, not power directly" model has drawn criticism as free to play "with an asterisk the size of a subscription fee." see the money panel for the full monetization breakdown. also see: aion2hub.com, date unknown3 free to play membership subscription market trading

title: Alt characters and the 84-run rule
text: alt characters and the 84-run rule past 84 dungeon clears a week, your whole account's tradeable kinah and gear drops get cut hard. what it is once an account registers 84 combined dungeon clears within a single weekly lockout period, tradeable kinah and gear drops are reduced (one source says by 90%) for the rest of that week, across all characters on the account, not just the one that hit the threshold. the restriction is account-wide by design, to stop players from running many alts to funnel loot onto one main character. youtube.com, kr-era1 mmoexp.com, date unknown2 kinah splits into bound kinah (non-tradeable, usable for npc costs) and tradeable kinah (broker-eligible); only tradeable drops are affected by the 84-run penalty, so bound-currency income for alts is unaffected. single source mmoexp.com, date unknown3 where the breakpoints are community guides suggest running up to roughly 84 dungeon clears per account per week for full kinah efficiency; beyond that, efficiency drops sharply, with a second breakpoint around 126 runs cited for players chasing materials rather than kinah. single source, unverified mmoexp.com, date unknown4 beginner tip: focus one main character until it reaches the power threshold where clears become fast, before investing in alts. per-character systems (daeva pass, stigma, gear) do not share progress. boostroom.com, 2026-025 mein-mmo.de, 2026-096 tension worth noting: the daeva pass is sold per character, which incentivizes alts, while the 84-run system discourages heavy alt-running for kinah. rolling one or two alts for daeva pass or side content appears fine; running dozens purely to farm dungeon loot is what the 84-run system targets. also see: vortexgaming.io, date unknown7 on alt leveling efficiency. alt characters 84 run penalty kinah dungeon

title: Settings and quality of life
text: settings and quality of life use the sanctioned two-skill auto-attack macro, rebind a few keys, and expect to tune graphics manually. macros ncsoft added an official auto-attack macro in a kr patch, kr-era limited to automating two specific skills, not a full auto-combat system. players reportedly combine it with auto-target settings at stationary farm spots, but guides warn that misusing or over-automating macros risks an account flag, so stick to the sanctioned two-skill macro. u4n.com, date unknown1 boostroom.com, 2026-022 key rebinds and controller suggested key rebinds: move the defiance/breakbar key off spacebar, bind sprint to shift, put your primary macro on the right mouse button, and enable combat info overlays plus the boss orientation indicator in the info display settings. single source, lower-trust mmoexp.com, date unknown3 controller support: not confirmed. the game appears designed around mouse and keyboard; no native controller support has been documented for kr/tw or announced for global. fextralife.com, date unknown4 beginner tip: set up build/gear presets early rather than manually reconfiguring your build every time you swap between pve and pvp, since manual swapping wastes time and causes configuration errors. boostroom.com, 2026-025 no sources documented specific graphics presets or fps benchmarks; expect to tune settings manually against the system requirements above once the client is available. the launch scale test (sept 17-18) is the first real chance to test performance. settings macros keybinds controller quality of life

title: First day
text: first day follow main story quests first, use region quests as a supplement, do not race. general consensus across guides: follow the main story (episode) quests first, use nearby region quests as a supplement, and treat the first days as a sequence of unlocks rather than a race. episode quests carry the most xp and gate which systems, zones, and mounts become available; region quests give lower xp but extra gear and daevanion crystals, unlocking once you meet their level requirement. exitlag.com, date unknown1 aion2wiki.com, date unknown2 do first: push episode/main story quests, days 1 to 2. campaign focus and early system unlocks single source expcarry.com, 2026-083. then: pick up region quests as they unlock for extra gear and daevanion crystals. later / optional: do not chase every side system the moment it appears, let the story pace your unlocks. first day episode region quests msq priority

title: First week
text: first week days 1-2 campaign, days 3-4 gear and first dungeons, days 5-7 settle into a routine. one guide's suggested first-week phase breakdown: days 1 to 2, campaign focus and system unlocks; days 3 to 4, gear reinforcement and first dungeons; days 5 to 7, settling into a sustainable daily/weekly routine. expcarry.com, 2026-081 do first: days 3 to 4, reinforce gear and clear your first dungeons once the story opens them up. then: days 5 to 7, settle into a sustainable daily and weekly routine rather than continuing to rush. see the systems and checklists panel for the actual daily/weekly task list. later / optional: if you are also doing side content beyond msq, expect this week to stretch a bit longer, see pacing below. first week gear dungeons routine

title: When to stop rushing and fix power walls
text: when to stop rushing and fix power walls push the story until you hit a genuine wall, then fix that one bottleneck before moving on. the recurring advice across multiple guides: push the main story until you hit a genuine power wall, a fight or dungeon you cannot clear, then stop and address that specific bottleneck (gear, a skill threshold, or a missing system) rather than grinding broadly or opening every menu as soon as it appears. expcarry.com, 2026-081 aion2wiki.com, kr-era2 beginner tip: "gear score" is community slang. the game itself uses item level (gear-only, gates dungeon entry) and combat power (a broader number including daevanion talents, pantheon unlocks, arcana cards, and skill levels). do not confuse the two: a dungeon's stated item-level minimum can still be a hard failure if your combat power isn't there yet. expcarry.com, 2026-083 mein-mmo.de, 2026-094 do first: when you hit a wall, diagnose it, is it gear (item level), build (combat power/skill thresholds), or a missing system, before grinding blindly. then: fix that specific bottleneck rather than broadly farming xp or opening unrelated systems. later / optional: only return to open-ended grinding once the wall is cleared and you are looking for general progress. power wall item level combat power gear score stopping point

title: Time to cap and pacing
text: time to cap and pacing budget 20-25 hours to cap if you touch side content; a rushed 12-15 hour msq run is weaker. experienced players following only the msq reportedly hit level 45 in about 12 to 15 hours; new players who also do side content should expect roughly 20 to 25 hours. expcarry.com, date unknown1 that extra time is described as producing a "significantly more functional" character at cap, with more daevanion points and gear investment, than rushing. unverified spot-check 2026-09-12: the cited page argues msq-first but contains no hour figures, so the 12 to 15 and 20 to 25 hour numbers are an uncorroborated estimate. beginner tip: unless you specifically want a speed-run, budget for the slower 20 to 25 hour pace. a more "functional" character at cap matters more than shaving a few hours off leveling. time to cap pacing leveling speed hours msq side content

title: Mastery Skills and Specialization
text: mastery skills and specialization mastery skills level automatically; spend skill points on your core 3-4 rotation abilities. what it is mastery skills are your core class abilities. they are learned automatically as you hit level requirements. expcarry, date unknown1 every level-up grants skill points, which you spend to raise a mastery skill up to a base cap of 10. youtube, date unknown2 ldcloud, date unknown3 how it works skill points can be refunded for a small kinah fee, so early experimentation is safe fextralife, date unknown4. daevanion board and gear effects can push a skill's effective level to 12 or 16, past the base cap of 10 fextralife, date unknown5. at skill breakpoints of level 8, 12, and 16, you can pick up to 3 additional chosen effects, called specialization fextralife, date unknown6 oslink, date unknown7. extra skill points come from empyrean traces, world collectibles turned in at a monolith for wisdom stones, an item that grants skill points on use. fextralife, date unknown8 a separate guide calls the same collectible simply "feathers" turned in at city monoliths. differ, date unknown9 korean class-board guides from 2026 routinely talk about pushing core skills to skill level 20, and some to 25, above the 8/12/16 breakpoints described here. that ceiling is reached with daevanion, stigma and arcana bonuses stacked on the base cap, and no single source states the current maximum, so treat the top breakpoint as kr-era and unverified for global kr-era inven, 2026-0210 dcinside, 202611. the per-class leveling build cards give the skill-level targets those guides use. naming is inconsistent between sources: "empyrean traces"/"wisdom stones" versus "feathers" are likely different translations of the same kr-era item, so treat the exact item names as contested. beginner priority beginner priority: put points into your main damage chain, a self-heal or hp recovery skill, and anything usable while moving, then push your rotation's core 3-4 abilities past the 8/12/16 breakpoints expcarry, date unknown12. common mistake common mistake: spreading skill points thin across many skills instead of concentrating on your rotation's core abilities. mastery skills specialization skill points wisdom stones empyrean traces

title: Stigma System
text: stigma system stigmas add build-defining abilities; sources disagree on exactly which levels unlock which slots. what it is stigmas are equippable skill-enhancement stones that add build-defining abilities on top of your class kit. expcarry, date unknown1 they consume a separate currency, stigma shards, rather than normal skill points. expcarry, date unknown2 unlock and cost one detailed source says the first stigma slot unlocks at level 23, with two more normal slots at 30 and 40, two greater stigma slots at 45 and 50, and a major stigma slot at 55 aion nova, date unknown3 differ, date unknown4. a second source instead says stigmas unlock at level 23 with up to four equipped at once, which conflicts with the 23/30/40/45/50/55 breakdown above aion2hub, date unknown5. level 45 is confirmed to unlock two greater stigma slots via a group quest, "the shattered stigma" for elyos or "the shulak's stigma" for asmodians differ, date unknown6. kr-era content raised the stigma level cap from 20 to 25, requiring a higher-tier shard above level 20; this is explicitly flagged as kr-only and unconfirmed for global expcarry, date unknown7 kr-era. beginner priority beginner priority: pick a single pve rotation and fund the stigmas that fill actual gaps in it, upgrading your most-used stigma first rather than spreading shards across every stigma you own expcarry, date unknown8 overgear, date unknown9. common mistake common mistake: building a pvp stigma set before you have a stable pve rotation, which wastes scarce shards. stigma shards skill enhancement pvp pve rotation

title: Daevanion Board
text: daevanion board six daevanion boards unlock through level 45 and add permanent combat stats separate from gear. what it is a permanent node-board progression system, separate from gear, that raises combat stats and effective skill levels. overgear, date unknown1 aion2hub, date unknown2 unlock and cost the first board unlocks at level 12; one detailed source states there are 6 total boards unlocking progressively, with the last two arriving at level 45 fextralife, date unknown3 talentbuilds, date unknown4. daevanion points unlock nodes; points and daevanion crystals both come from regional quests, sealed dungeons, strongholds, achievements, and exploration overgear, date unknown5 expcarry, date unknown6 differ, date unknown7. the kr client can reset a whole board or individual nodes, with a single-node reset costing 500 kinah in korea. expcarry, date unknown8 kr-era, self-flagged as provisional a node cannot be removed while another already-acquired node depends on it. the source explicitly flags that global's final reset costs, caps, and terminology may differ from what shipped in korea. separately, korean community discussion claims a recent patch "significantly reduced" reset costs for both skills and daevanion nodes, without giving a before/after number, consistent with but not independent confirmation of the 500 kinah figure. single source, vague liveissue.kr, date unknown9 how it works gold/orange nodes are passive stat boosts, blue nodes amplify active skills, and green nodes optimize existing passives like resource regen, per one summary. expcarry, date unknown10 a second source describes essentially the same split as "skill nodes" and "stat nodes" without the color breakdown, a likely simplification rather than a contradiction. the board is cited as a source of 500+ "passive" combat power that does not require gear swapping, earned by clearing hidden question-mark dungeons, sealed dungeons, and strongholds u4n, date unknown11. beginner priority beginner priority: trace the cheapest path to skill/stat nodes that support one specific loadout, comparing full routes by total point cost rather than grabbing every nearby node purely for combat power expcarry, date unknown12. common mistake common mistake: neglecting the board while rushing the main story; it's a significant permanent power source that's easy to overlook overgear, date unknown13. no official aion 2 global skill or stigma-name glossary has been published pre-launch. the official global-facing material found only confirms the roster of 8 launch classes plus an unconfirmed 9th (brawler, seen in kr/tw) and a launch scale test running september 17-18, 2026 single source, marketing-aggregator, not the official site itself mmoculture, 2026-0714. all node and skill names used on this page are fan translations from community guides, not official localizations, unless otherwise noted. daevanion board nodes points crystals progression

title: Arcana
text: arcana arcana cards add item level, stats, and set bonuses; fill every slot rather than chasing perfect rarity. what it is a card-based system that adds item level, combat stats, set bonuses, and effective skill levels all at once. expcarry, date unknown1 original slot types are chalice, parchment, compass, bell, and mirror; later content reportedly added scales, key, hourglass, dice, and lantern, for up to nine slots total. expcarry, date unknown2 vortex gaming, date unknown3 more precisely, the card-slot rollout came in generations: the original five (chalice, parchment, compass, bell, mirror), scales added in "season 2," and key, hourglass, dice, and lantern added in "chapter 1." single source expcarry, date unknown4 rarity tiers cited are common (about +20 item level), rare (+40), epic (+60), and unique (+80), affecting a card's overall item-level contribution. expcarry, date unknown5 a separate source uses "green 40, blue 60, unique 80" for the same slots, suggesting a rarity-name translation mismatch between sources. how it works cards come primarily from transcendence dungeons tied to specific slots, sets, and crystal families, expcarry, date unknown6 overgear, date unknown7 plus crafting/synthesis, extraction from unwanted cards, and events. the guidance is to pick a dungeon for its arcana output rather than for its difficulty stage alone. single source expcarry, date unknown8 cards gain experience from training arcana consumables (lesser 200 exp, intermediate 600, superior 1,500, ultimate 3,000) or by feeding in other cards. expcarry, date unknown9 skill-level bonuses stack with stigma and daevanion bonuses toward the same 16-20 breakpoints. equipping five different cards is separately said to "significantly increase" skill levels and combat power. aion2hub, date unknown10 targeted cards can also be crafted directly using tiered crystals, mysterious, harmonious, noble, or splendent noble depending on card generation, plus kinah single source, detailed expcarry, date unknown11. beginner priority beginner priority: fill every slot with something usable rather than waiting for a perfect unique card, protect skill breakpoints and set bonuses over raw item level, save training arcana for cards you plan to keep, and farm the transcendence dungeon that matches the slot or crystal family you actually need expcarry, date unknown12. common mistake common mistake: leaving slots empty, farming the wrong dungeon for prestige, over-enhancing filler cards, or destroying a card before confirming its replacement is actually equipped expcarry, date unknown13. flag: this progression system, dungeon-gated drops, tiered exp materials, and crystal crafting, is exactly the kind of thing that could change materially for global launch, so treat every figure above as kr-era kr-era. no official global skill-name glossary exists either, so card-to-skill assignments quoted elsewhere on this page are fan translations, not confirmed localizations mmoculture, 2026-0714. arcana cards item level transcendence set effects

title: Equipment Grades and Enhancement
text: equipment grades and enhancement gear grade names vary by source; enhance evenly across slots before pushing any one piece high. what it is ncsoft's own patch notes reportedly confirm at least heroic and unique grades, with unique higher. exitlag, date unknown1 community sources also describe a wider tier list, rare from standard dungeons, unique from hard mode, legendary from nightmare/abyss content, alongside a separate green/blue/purple/gold color scheme used for pantheon items, so grade naming is not fully consistent across sources. how it works enhance stones raise a gear piece's level; enchanting adds pve attack/defense on pve gear or pvp attack/defense on pvp gear depending on item type exitlag, date unknown2. failing an enchant does not destroy the item, and extracting a previously-enhanced item refunds 100% of the enhance stones spent into it exitlag, date unknown3 fextralife, date unknown4. suggested safe breakpoints to stop and bank kinah: +3-5, +8 ("damage smoothing", especially for weapons), +10 (feels properly progressed), +12 (controlled risk on good gear), and +15 (only for long-term keeper gear) boostroom, date unknown5. mana stones socket into gear for stats like crit rate or speed, helping gear "scale into late-game without major farming" alongside soul codexes. u4n, date unknown6 fextralife, date unknown7 a separate single source describes an "engraving" mechanic where one attempt rerolls every socket, uncorroborated elsewhere. gear comes from questing, world/dungeon loot, and the player marketplace or broker fextralife, date unknown8. beginner priority beginner priority: enhance your weapon first since it gives the single biggest damage boost, then survivability armor, then remaining armor, then accessories last boostroom, date unknown9 overgear, date unknown10. common mistake avoid: pushing one piece to a high, risky enhancement level before your other slots have reached a low safe tier. equipment grades enhancement enchanting sockets weapon

title: Manastones and Theostones
text: manastones and theostones mana stones and theostones are socketed gems and weapon procs, slot them in as they drop. what it is mana stones are aion 2's socketed stat gems, found via dungeons, rewards, or crafting. u4n, date unknown1 fextralife, date unknown2 theostones are the weapon proc-stone equivalent of classic aion's godstones. how it works theostones socket into a weapon's dedicated slot and grant a chance-on-hit proc effect such as damage or a debuff; one effect per weapon, and identical theostones do not stack aion2.online, date unknown3. a community database lists 153 known theostones, corroborated across three independent sources aion2.online, date unknown4 aion2hub, date unknown5. beginner priority beginner priority: treat mana stones and theostones as gradual scaling tools you slot in as they drop, rather than something to farm dedicated runs for early on. manastones theostones godstone sockets weapon proc

title: Soul Binding
text: soul binding one uncorroborated source says bound gear gains a growing secondary stat; bind and use gear normally. what it is described by one fan-run compiled wiki as a secondary stat block on gear that "only grows once you bind it." kodex.yavuz, date unknown1 this is likely analogous to classic aion's soul-binding-on-equip mechanic but with an added stat-growth twist here. not corroborated by any other source found; treat the whole mechanic as single-source and uncertain until confirmed elsewhere. beginner priority beginner priority: bind and use gear normally, since even the single source describing this doesn't suggest a reason to delay binding. soul binding gear stat growth uncertain

title: Pantheon
text: pantheon pantheon is an unconfirmed passive-stat system, slot pieces in opportunistically, don't farm it dedicated. what it is an "often overlooked" permanent passive-stat system built from statues, colossi, and "artwork"/frameworks; placing a colossus into a pantheon slot grants points toward one of several "deity domains," each capping at 200 points before converting into flat combat stats. vortex gaming, date unknown1 rsnxt, date unknown2 how it works item rarity (green to blue to purple to gold) determines each piece's bonus strength, with green giving 40 stat points and blue 60 in one cited example. named domains include wisdom (strike chance/final damage), freedom (accuracy/evasion), and death (critical hit chance) vortex gaming, date unknown3. this system rests on a small cluster of corroborating community sources, mostly one aggregator plus a boosting site, with no wiki or database confirmation found. treat the whole pantheon system as not independently confirmed, though the name itself appears consistently. beginner priority beginner priority: treat pantheon pieces as passive value you slot in opportunistically rather than a system worth dedicated farming until it's better confirmed for global. pantheon statues colossi artwork passive stats

title: Titles, Achievements, and Collections
text: titles, achievements, and collections achievements and titles come from normal play, don't farm them as a separate track. what it is achievements grant achievement points and rewards, and completing them ties into daevanion point/crystal income. differ, date unknown1 how it works one database lists 1,307 achievements, while a differing count elsewhere cites 4,225 named achievements across grades, categories, and factions, of which 2,685 grant rewards; likely different snapshots or counting methods aion2hub, date unknown2. titles: one source counts 1,472 total titles with 844 granting stat bonuses, earned via pvp rank, arena tiers, boss kills, monster-hunting milestones, server-first accomplishments, and mini-game/event wins. aion2hub, date unknown3 stat titles grant things like pvp attack, pvp accuracy, hp, defense, combat/move speed, or critical hit; some titles are purely cosmetic. a separate source states you can have 3 active title effects at once across offensive/defensive/other categories, unlocking around level 30; this slot count and level could not be cross-confirmed, treat as single-source. an appearance collection (wardrobe) exists; collecting roughly 700 appearances grants combat speed and cooldown reduction as a milestone bonus. vortex gaming, date unknown4 cash-shop cosmetics do not count toward this bonus, though they do count for achievements. beginner priority beginner priority: don't farm titles or achievements as a separate track early; treat them as a byproduct of normal questing and dungeon clears, and periodically check the achievement panel for cheap stat titles you already qualify for. titles achievements collections codex wardrobe

title: Pets and Mounts
text: pets and mounts pets double as mounts, farm 10 "souls" of a monster to unlock each one. what it is pets and mounts are the same system in aion 2: any pet you own can also be ridden as a mount. u4n, date unknown1 fextralife, date unknown2 over 200 pets are collectible. boostroom, date unknown3 how it works the main method is farming 10 "souls" of almost any monster to unlock it as a pet/mount; souls also drop from the shugo shop and the black cloud merchant, and rare mounts can come from hidden cubes fextralife, date unknown4. the in-game pets menu has a "source" tab showing exactly where a given soul drops. beginner priority beginner priority: don't ignore world mobs while leveling, many double as free future mounts once you've collected 10 souls; check the source tab before grinding blindly for a specific pet. pets mounts souls collection

title: Wings and Flight
text: wings and flight flight is a real combat mechanic, not cosmetic; wings and mounts are complementary tools. what it is flight is a core combat and traversal mechanic, not just cosmetic transportation; some abyss boss mechanics reportedly require flight to execute correctly. thegamer, date unknown1 u4n, date unknown2 unlock and cost wings are not available from level 1; one single, unverified source gives a rough unlock around level 10. how it works wings have a "flight power" stat acting as airborne stamina; upgrading a wing raises max flight power via a physics-based "glide gauge" rather than a rigid timer thegamer, date unknown3 u4n, date unknown4. only wings earned through gameplay grant flight power; purchased cosmetic wing skins sit in a separate skin slot layered over your earned wings and provide no flight benefit thegamer, date unknown5. higher-quality wings also add flat attack/defense/hp and can grant movement speed or special combat effects. beginner priority beginner priority: use mounts as your short-range sprint tool and wings/gliding as your long-range terrain-skip tool, they're complementary, not redundant. manage your glide gauge deliberately, since running out mid-air just drops you. wings flight glide gauge flight power

title: Legion
text: legion legions cap at 128 members and offer organization and group access; the level, hall and buff perks below are disputed. what it is aion 2's guild system, capped at up to 128 members per legion, used for pve, pvp, crafting, and social access. exitlag, date unknown1 6sword, date unknown2 legion perks are mostly about organization and access to reliable groups rather than direct stat buffs. mmoexp, date unknown3 how it works legion hall unlocks at legion level 5, costs 1,000,000 kinah to rent, and houses cooking, alchemy, jewelcrafting, armorsmithing, and blacksmithing merchants/workbenches together, the real convenience benefit mmoexp, date unknown4. legion coin is earned for active contribution and spent on legion-exclusive skins, uniforms, masks, mounts, and wings at specialized merchants u4n, date unknown5. legion levels beyond 5 raise the member cap and unlock member access to purchase or use new abyss weapons and armor mmoexp, date unknown6. disputed: the legion level, legion hall unlock and abyss-gear perks above come from a single boosting-adjacent source. three independent sources say legions have no levels, warehouse or mechanical buffs, and a developer statement from february 2026 agrees. see the "legion: rank structure and the warehouse/buff controversy" card further down this page. beginner priority beginner priority: join an active legion early for group content access and legion hall crafting convenience; don't expect membership itself to be a large stat boost. legion guild hall coin crafting

title: Companions / Summoned Spirits
text: companions / summoned spirits there's no universal companion system, only the spiritmaster's four elemental summon spirits. what it is there is no evidence of a general, class-agnostic "companion" or "summon" progression system in aion 2. the only summon-type mechanic found is class-specific to the spiritmaster, which channels four elemental spirits (fire, water, wind, earth) as combat pets/turrets with independent attack capability, used to chain skill activations for dps. fextralife, date unknown1 mmoexp, date unknown2 treat "companions" as not a universal system; it is a spiritmaster kit feature, not something every character has. companions summons spiritmaster class specific

title: Stats That Matter
text: stats that matter pve and pvp stats are fully separate pools; build your pve set first and ignore pvp caps for now. what it is accuracy governs the chance to land an attack and, per one source, also affects crit chance; precision is a hybrid stat raising both accuracy and crit chance. u4n, date unknown1 how it works pve attack/defense only comes from pve gear and only affects damage to monsters; pvp attack/defense only comes from pvp gear and only affects damage to other players exitlag, date unknown2. one source states endgame pve targets are roughly accuracy 2350 and critical hit 2600-2700 depending on synergy/buffs. u4n, date unknown3 the combat power formula itself stops rewarding further accuracy above 1700 or crit above 80%, making stacking past those levels inefficient for combat power purposes. because burst damage is high (one source claims an assassin can deal about 80% of a target's hp in one combo), the recommended early pvp stat order is hp, crit resistance, mitigation, then pvp defense. boostroom, date unknown4 pvp attack is added only once survival is established. beginner priority beginner priority: build one pve stat set first and don't chase pvp stat caps until you're actually pvping regularly. stats accuracy crit attack pve pvp split

title: Combat Power ("Atul") and Item Level
text: combat power ("atul") and item level item level gates content access; combat power is a separate aggregate score, raise both from cheap broad sources first. what it is there appear to be two related but distinct numbers: item level, which gates access to activities such as transcendence content around 900-2700+ tiers, and combat power or "atul score," an aggregate power estimate used for matchmaking/ranking-style comparisons. fextralife, date unknown1 u4n, date unknown2 the "atul" naming is single-source and could be a translation artifact; treat with caution. how it works fastest ways to raise combat power, per multiple sources: even gear enhancement across all slots up to a low safe tier before pushing any one piece further filling daevanion board nodes (500+ passive cp cited) collecting/upgrading arcana cards (400+ cp cited) raising accuracy toward roughly 1200+ via ariel, wings, magic stones, and the sanctuary bracelet completing early permanent items like the noble belt and revelation amulet vortex gaming, date unknown3 u4n, date unknown4 rushing the yellow (main story) quest line is also cited as a fast way to raise base stats and thus cp u4n, date unknown5. beginner priority beginner priority: chase the cheap, broad cp sources first (daevanion nodes, arcana, main story) before grinding for marginal gear enhancement gains. combat power item level atul score cp

title: Transcendence and Odyle Energy
text: transcendence and odyle energy odyle energy opens reward cubes after a clear, not dungeon entry, and it's shared across normal and transcendence runs. what it is transcendence is aion 2's endgame progression/ranking layer, class-ranked, fed by specific dungeons such as "phantom corridor" with up to 4 escalating difficulty levels that raise the minimum entry combat power and monster strength; main rewards are arcana cards plus breakthrough stone fragments and stigma shard fragments (single source, kr-era). how it works as of a july 1, 2026 patch, entry tickets for expedition and transcendence dungeons were removed; instead, odyle energy is spent only to open the reward cube after clearing a run. aion2hub, 2026-071 u4n, date unknown2 a normal boss cube costs 40 energy and hard difficulty costs 60, and normal/transcendence dungeons draw from the same shared energy pool. one source states transcendence content becomes available around gear score ~1650, unverified elsewhere kodex.yavuz, date unknown3. no evidence was found of a traditional "class advancement" or ascension tier in aion 2. what exists instead is transcendence dungeons plus "awakening battles," timed solo encounters with extra objectives and temporary combat bonuses, a separate activity track from episode/region/mission content (single source, could not verify further). beginner priority beginner priority: entry itself isn't gated by energy, so you can scout transcendence dungeons early, but budget your odyle energy between normal and transcendence content since they share one pool. transcendence odyle energy dungeons endgame

title: Crafting, Gathering, and Cooking
text: crafting, gathering, and cooking five crafting professions share one gathering skill; pick one or two rather than spreading thin. what it is five primary crafting professions are cited: blacksmithing, armor smithing, handicrafting, alchemy, and cooking. exitlag, date unknown1 expcarry, date unknown2 cooking produces food/drink buffs used before dungeons and pvp. how it works gathering is done via an "essence extraction" skill/action used to mine ore, gather herbs, or cut wood, feeding all five crafting lines. no evidence found of a dedicated dyeing system; classic aion had player-dye mechanics, so its absence here is flagged as unverified rather than confirmed absent. beginner priority beginner priority: pick one or two gathering skills that match your intended crafting profession rather than spreading thin, and use the legion hall once available (legion level 5) to access all five crafting stations in one place mmoexp, date unknown3. crafting gathering cooking professions essence extraction

title: Currencies
text: currencies kinah is the only broker currency; everything else is earned and spent within its own system. a quick reference for every currency mentioned across the systems above. u4n, date unknown1 currencyearned fromspent onsrc kinahquests, monster kills, dungeons, vendor salesrepairs, soul-binding, crafting materials, teleports, gear enhancement, the only currency usable on the brokeru4n, date unknown qunareal-money purchase; tradeable for kinah via currency exchangecosmetics, weapon/mount/wing skins, battle pass premium tiersu4n, date unknown abyss pointsdaily/weekly pvp-zone questspresumed abyss-specific gear/items, not independently confirmedfextralife-derived, single source legion coinactive legion contributionlegion-exclusive cosmetics, mounts, wingsu4n, date unknown daevanion crystalsquests, dungeons, achievementsunlocking daevanion board nodesexpcarry, date unknown wisdom stonesexchanging empyrean traces/feathers at a monolithgrants skill points on usefextralife, date unknown stigma shardsnot detailed in sourcesleveling stigma skills; higher-tier shards for kr levels 21-25expcarry, date unknown enhance stonesnot detailed in sourcesraising gear enhancement levelexitlag, date unknown centuryroot tokennot detailed in sourcesshugo festival seasonal shop; purpose beyond that unverifiedfextralife-derived, single source odyle energy / grace of odylepassive regen, plus other sources detailed in the dungeons guideopening reward cubes after expedition/transcendence/sanctuary dungeon clearsaion2hub, 2026-07 no evidence was found of a separate generic "gems" currency distinct from the above; treat "gems" as not confirmed to exist as a distinct aion 2 currency. currencies kinah quna abyss points daevanion crystals

title: Character Creation and Customization
text: character creation and customization character creation runs before level 1 with 200+ sliders and presets, but changing your look later needs an unclear cash-shop item. what it is character creation runs after the opening combat tutorial and story introduction, covering body type, face, hair, and body-shape sliders plus ready-made presets ncsoft official, 2025-11-161. ncsoft's own figure is "more than 200 customization options" spanning body shape, skin tone, eye color, and muscle definition ncsoft official, 2025-11-162. how it works four sections: body type, face, hair and makeup, and body shape fextralife, date unknown3 timesaver.gg, date unknown4 body type: masculine frames lean armor-like, feminine frames lean dresses/skirts/heels. face: eyebrows, eyes, iris, nose, lips. hair and makeup: available regardless of body type. body shape: height, limb proportions, muscularity, regional thickness. ready-made presets are organized by race, gender, and role so you can skip detailed sculpting timesaver.gg, date unknown5 faction, class, and race are treated as permanent, with no swap service announced for global as of 2026-09-12 timesaver.gg, date unknown6 once creation is finished, you cannot change your physical appearance without "a special kind of currency," per the community wiki, which does not name it fextralife, date unknown7. a second source frames this as "likely possible through a cash-shop restyle item" but says ncsoft has not published a specific item, currency, or global price single source, speculative timesaver.gg, date unknown8. beginner priority beginner priority: use a preset close to what you want rather than free-sculpting from scratch if you won't spend real time on it, since changing your look later needs a currency or item that isn't clearly defined yet for global. watch out avoid: assuming you can freely re-roll your face later the way some other mmos allow. budget your creation-screen time up front. character creation customization face body hair presets style shop

title: Housing
text: housing player housing is confirmed and in development, but not live yet on kr/tw and not guaranteed for global day one. what it is a confirmed, in-development player housing system with exterior decoration (fences, statues, decorations) and interior furniture placement mmoexp, 2026-07-281. pets and mounts are shown living inside and around houses, consistent with aion 2's unified pet/mount system mmoexp, 2026-07-282. how it works status as of 2026-07-28: "actively in development." mmoexp, 2026-07-283 expected on kr/tw "within the next few months as part of early chapter updates." global housing is expected "at or shortly after" the october 5, 2026 worldwide release. ncsoft has not confirmed exact dates, unlock requirements, or costs. until housing ships, the pantheon system already gives a private space to place "trophies and artwork" for stat bonuses, but without free-form furniture placement, per the same article beginner priority beginner priority: don't hold back on pantheon investment while waiting for housing, they're described as separate systems, and pantheon is confirmed live now while housing is not. watch out avoid: assuming housing is available at global launch day one. treat it as likely but not confirmed for day one. housing player house decoration furniture upcoming

title: Accessories: Class Runes, Belts, and Amulets
text: accessories: class runes, belts, and amulets two good runes are worth about 80 item levels, but stop enhancing at +1, a failed +2 attempt can break the rune. what it is a dedicated accessory slot type distinct from manastones, theostones, and arcana cards. named examples include clash rune and devotion rune fextralife, date unknown1. runes are classed as accessories, obtained through quest completion, exploration, enemy drops, crafting, and merchant purchase, same as other accessory gear fextralife, date unknown2. how it works equipping two good runes is worth roughly 80 item levels, corroborated by two independent sources with nearly identical wording hackquest/mmoexp, date unknown3 kodex.yavuz, date unknown4 enhancement warning: stop rune enhancement at +1. from +2 onward, a failed attempt can break the rune entirely single source kodex.yavuz, date unknown5 a dedicated video guide titled "how to unlock the rune accessory slot" implies runes aren't available from level 1 and need a specific quest or milestone; the exact requirement is unconfirmed single source, title only youtube, date unknown6 this guide's combat power card already names the noble belt and revelation amulet as early permanent item-level gains. no further independent detail on belts or amulets as their own mechanical system was found beyond being accessory gear slots. beginner priority beginner priority: treat the rune slot as a big, cheap power spike once unlocked, two decent runes are worth roughly a full enhancement tier's worth of item level. watch out avoid: pushing rune enhancement past +1 before confirming whether global carries the same break-on-fail risk as kr. accessories runes belts amulets item level enhancement

title: Transfer Crafting
text: transfer crafting one source describes a crafting process that carries enhancement progress into an upgraded item, but it's unconfirmed elsewhere. what it is a crafting process, distinct from normal enhance stone enchanting, that lets a player carry a gear piece's enhancement level, amplification, and soul binding progress forward into its next-tier upgrade rather than starting over kodex.yavuz, date unknown1. how it works the same source states the process is "guaranteed to succeed," unlike normal enhancement rolls, and that the resulting upgraded item becomes soul bound to the crafter as part of the transfer. not corroborated by any second source. treat the existence, exact mechanics, and required materials as unconfirmed until seen elsewhere. this source is already flagged elsewhere in this guide as one whose single-sourced terms should be treated cautiously. beginner priority beginner priority: if this system exists as described, it removes the fear of "wasting" enhancement investment when upgrading to a better base item. until corroborated, don't plan your enhancement spending around the assumption that progress definitely transfers. transfer crafting gear upgrade soul binding carry over

title: Legion: Rank Structure and the Warehouse/Buff Controversy
text: legion: rank structure and the warehouse/buff controversy three independent sources say legions have no warehouse, buffs, or levels, contradicting several community guides. what it is newly confirmed: legions have a legion master and an officer corps; only an officer can rent the legion hideout, at 1,000,000 kinah for 23 days and 15 hours, matching the 1,000,000 kinah rent figure in the legion card above and adding the exact duration guildmanager.app, date unknown1. the same source states it is explicitly not confirmed how many rank tiers exist, whether rank names can be customized, or what a full permission matrix contains, despite some guides presenting specific rank ladders as fact. how it works that source states plainly that legions have "no levels, no buffs, no crafting, no rankings, no warehouse." guildmanager.app, date unknown2 attributed to ncsoft developers. it calls out that guides describing legion warehouses, buffs, and legion-unlocked fortress sieges draw on "an ai-generated page" that invented those features, citing a developer denial dated february 2026. a second, independent source agrees: aion 2's developers "have publicly discussed legions as intentionally limited." boostroom, date unknown3 no heavy legion leveling or special buff trees as a core requirement. it explicitly lists legion levels, warehouses, stat buffs, and crafting bonuses as absent. a third source repeats the no-warehouse claim, also attributed to ncsoft developer commentary without a direct quote or link guildmanager.app, date unknown4 beginner priority beginner priority: don't join a legion expecting a warehouse, guild-wide buffs, or a leveling structure that unlocks more perks over time. do still join one for the confirmed, undisputed benefits: coordinated scheduling, reliable groups, and the hideout itself once an officer rents it. watch out direct conflict: the legion card above states, from a single boosting-adjacent source, that "legion hall unlocks at legion level 5," houses five crafting professions' stations, and that "legion levels beyond 5 raise the member cap and unlock member access to purchase or use new abyss weapons and armor." three independent sources dispute legion levels, warehouses, and mechanical buffs entirely, and one names "an ai-generated page" as the likely origin of exactly this kind of fabricated claim. treat the legion hall level-5, crafting-unlock and legion-coin claims as contested rather than confirmed. avoid: picking a legion based on advertised "legion level" or "legion buffs" claims that may not exist in the shipped game. legion guild ranks officer warehouse buffs contested

title: PvP Ranking Tiers and Season Leaderboards
text: pvp ranking tiers and season leaderboards a 20-tier seasonal pvp ladder sits on top of abyss points; the gap between low and top tiers is enormous, don't chase rank casually. what it is a seasonal ranking ladder layers on top of the abyss points system described in the dungeons section. one fan database documents 20 tiers for a completed kr/tw season, from trainee (unranked) up through ninth- through first-class soldier, one-star through five-star officer, general, marshal, commander, and a single supreme commander slot for the server's top player aion2hub, date unknown1. how it works concrete point thresholds: ninth-class soldier requires 3,000 ranking points, while the single supreme commander slot requires 25,000,000 aion2hub, date unknown2 tiered rewards are listed as titles, statues, pets, coins, and class-specific gear varying by rank and class; the exact reward table per tier was not found a separate, related page tracks abyss race-ranking rewards for holding artifacts and topping abyss world-boss damage/participation, distinct from the general season ladder aion2hub, date unknown3 the titles card notes titles come partly "via pvp rank, arena tiers." it doesn't describe the ladder itself. the dungeons page covers the abyss zone, arenas, and the contested status of fortress sieges as activities, but not this seasonal structure. one source describes the abyss zone as "the central inter-server abyss battleground," implying cross-server matchmaking or population-sharing, not independently corroborated single source u4n, date unknown4 two unverified third-party live-tracking tools exist for current standings: shugo.gg5 and aionflex6, neither an official source beginner priority beginner priority: don't chase rank early. the point gap between low and top tiers (3,000 vs 25,000,000) is enormous and clearly meant for dedicated, server-leading pvp players; casual pvp for gear and abyss points doesn't require caring about season rank at all. pvp ranking season leaderboard abyss rank tiers arena

title: Pet Power: Genus Insight and the Possession Effect
text: pet power: genus insight and the possession effect leveling pets passively raises your combat power through a "genus insight" possession effect, not just acquisition and riding. what it is the pets and mounts card covers how to obtain pets (farming 10 souls per monster) but not what leveling them does for combat power. how it works leveling and collecting pets contributes passive combat power through a mechanic described as "pet genus insight" and a "possession effect," where raising a pet's level increases the effect and, in turn, the owner's combat power vortex gaming, date unknown1 vortex gaming, date unknown2. some individual pets carry unique active-use combat abilities, for example a "fire spirit pup" with a fire attack skill effective against mid-level mobs. both sources trace to the same site, so treat this as effectively single-source despite being split across two articles. the genus insight/possession-effect terminology is not corroborated elsewhere. beginner priority beginner priority: this reinforces the pets and mounts card's advice to not ignore world mobs while leveling, pet collection has a passive combat power payoff on top of mount-riding convenience. watch out avoid: treating pets as purely cosmetic collectibles and skipping soul farming once you have a mount you like. pets combat power genus insight possession effect addendum

title: Odella and the Odyle Energy Naming Question
text: odella and the odyle energy naming question odella is likely the same resource this guide already calls odyle energy, but no source confirms the two names are identical. what it is odella is a high-tier gathering material, obtained from gathering nodes and defeating an "inder boss" encountered while gathering, at roughly 6 odella per gathering session vortex gaming, date unknown1. how it works the same source states odella is used to craft "odella energy," a daevanion crystal-equivalent material, higher-tier wings, and other equipment, with a related crafting process resetting weekly (wednesday 5 am per the source), capping players at 7 crafts per week. naming flag: the transcendence/odyle energy card and currencies table both use "odyle energy" (also seen as "grace of odyle") for the resource spent to open dungeon reward cubes, sourced from a dated aion2hub patch-notes translation. "odella energy," independently described as crafted from the odella gathering material, is very likely the same underlying kr-language resource under a different fan transliteration, since both are consistently tied to dungeon/endgame progression, but no source explicitly states the two names refer to the same currency. contested, unconfirmed whether odella energy = odyle energy beginner priority beginner priority: if you see "odella" in a kr-era guide and "odyle energy" elsewhere in this compendium, don't assume they're unrelated systems, they're most likely translation variants of the same mechanic, but don't assume they're definitely identical either until an official global glossary exists. odella odyle energy gathering material naming

title: Odyle Energy Explained
text: odyle energy explained energy only gates reward cubes, not dungeon entry; spend it daily so it never caps out. what it is the core resource is a stamina-like pool that gates dungeon reward claiming, not dungeon entry itself. energy does not block entering or clearing a dungeon; it only gates opening the final reward cube at the end. running a dungeon with insufficient energy still lets you clear it, just with no loot from that cube. u4n, 2026-051 overgear, 2026-092 naming is inconsistent across english fan sites: "odell energy," "odyle energy," "odile energy," and "aetherine energy" all appear to refer to the same underlying system, which the korean community calls od energy. u4n, 2026-053 u4n, 2026-064 overgear, 2026-095 mmoexp, 2026-096. cost and caps opening a boss/reward cube costs 40 energy, cited consistently for high-level conquest and transcendence dungeons u4n, 2026-057 thegameswiki, 2026-068 mmoexp, date unknown9. multiple sources give a maximum cap of 560 energy, beyond which passive regeneration stops and overflow is wasted thegameswiki, 2026-0610 mmoexp, date unknown11. base regen is cited as 15 energy every 3 hours by u4n, but a korean source states this already includes a 50% membership bonus, implying a non-member base rate closer to 10 per 3 hours. u4n, 2026-0512 savetip.co.kr, 202513 that's roughly 80/day, about 560/week, which would make "560" possibly a weekly-accumulation figure as much as a hard cap. the same korean source states total weekly od energy obtainable is 1,400, broken down as: savetip.co.kr, 202514 base passive charge with membership: about 840/week crafted material-conversion items: about 280/week wind breeze merchant purchase: about 280/week small unreliable drops from faction quests, field orders, and abyss orders players can craft energy-restoring stones, capped at 7 per week, each restoring 40 energy u4n, 2026-0515. other rules normal/exploration dungeons, party dungeons, and transcendence dungeons all draw from the same energy pool, there is no separate currency per dungeon type u4n, 2026-0516 thegameswiki, 2026-0617. membership tiers increase the charge rate by 50%, increase the odyle energy cube selection count in expedition/transcendence/sanctuary content, and double weekly abyss access hours aion2hub, date unknown18. one source states characters begin generating this energy at level 22 mmoexp, 2026-0919. separate from energy, individual dungeon types also carry their own entry-count limits, such as 7 entries per week for daily/party dungeons, expandable via purchasable tickets. u4n, 2026-0620 energy and entry counts are two separate gating systems that both apply at once. auto-hunt/expedition energy draw is unverified: no source confirms or denies whether open-world auto-hunt consumes this pool. beginner priority beginner priority: spend energy daily so it never sits at the cap, since regen stops there and future income is lost; never spend it on a weak reward pool relative to your current gear bottleneck. common mistake common mistake: letting energy sit at the cap while questing, which wastes ongoing regeneration. odyle energy od energy cap regen reward cube

title: Where to Spend Energy: Levels 1-25
text: where to spend energy: levels 1-25 no energy to manage yet, just front-load free story and sealed dungeon content. energy does not even begin accruing until roughly level 22 (single source, unverified). before that, guides consistently say don't think about dungeon energy at all. do first: front-load free, non-gated content, the main story quest line and sealed dungeons for daevanion points mmoexp, 2026-091 overgear, 2026-092. then: get your skill/stigma setup running and clear feather/exploration content while it's still free. later / optional: run fire temple for its high drop rate of unique items and kinah, since it doesn't rely on the energy pool at all aion2kina, date unknown3. beginner priority: several sources explicitly say to complete free exploration first before spending any gated resource, since there is no gated resource yet to worry about. beginner priority leveling energy early game

title: Where to Spend Energy: Levels 25-45
text: where to spend energy: levels 25-45 bank energy rather than dumping it into low-value leveling dungeons at this stage. guides agree that low-level dungeons are a poor use of energy at this stage. do first: bank energy without letting it cap out and waste regen, rather than dumping it into leveling dungeons mmoexp, 2026-091. then: run fire temple, abyss depths, and draconian bastion for the gear and mechanics they teach, not for their cube rewards aion2kina, date unknown2. later / optional: avoid premature dungeon runs purely for energy value; lower-level dungeons "waste limited energy that could fuel higher-reward content" once you're closer to endgame. common mistake: spending energy on low-level dungeons before your item level supports stronger, heroic-quality-gear content. beginner priority leveling energy mid game

title: Where to Spend Energy: Level 45+
text: where to spend energy: level 45+ gear up first, then spend energy on transcendence and conquest for the best return. multiple sources converge on the same order of operations for endgame energy spend. do first: complete endgame quests for initial blue normal-tier gear before spending energy at all. do first: once geared, prioritize transcendence and conquest dungeons for energy spend, since these give the best return on your 40-energy investment and the highest-value drops u4n, 2026-051 aion2kina, date unknown2. then: farm heroic-tier dungeons, recommended about 3 runs/day, for purple gear. then: run the highest expedition tier your group can clear reliably, not the hardest tier available; failed or wasted runs burn entries and energy for nothing overgear, 2026-093. later / optional: wait well above the posted minimum item level (~1400-1500 cited for conquest) before spending energy there; legendary-tier and conquest dungeons at minimum listed item level are explicitly called a trap for beginners mmoexp, date unknown4. common mistake: trusting the minimum listed item level on conquest/legendary content and getting into runs your group can't actually clear. beginner priority endgame energy transcendence conquest expeditions

title: Auto-Hunt Reality Check
text: auto-hunt reality check there's no true afk auto-battle system, don't plan your leveling around one. aion 2 does not have a true built-in afk auto-battle system comparable to mobile mmos. the combat design is action-oriented, positioning, timing, interrupts, which works against passive afk play u4n, date unknown1. some players use the in-game macro system plus auto-target to semi-automate stationary grinding, holding or spamming one key while multitasking, but this is not fully hands-off. do not confuse aion 2 with original aion's later-patch "auto hunting" feature, that is a different game. no source found documents specific afk/grinding spots by level range, nor confirms whether energy is consumed by any auto-hunt mechanic, since no full auto-hunt mechanic was confirmed to exist at all. treat this whole sub-topic as largely unverified pending global launch. avoid: planning around afk auto-hunt as a leveling strategy. auto hunt afk grinding macro

title: Group Etiquette and Roles
text: group etiquette and roles groups run the classic tank/healer/dps trinity plus an optional flex support slot. group content uses the classic mmo trinity, tank, healer, dps, with an optional flex/support slot in 4-player content. a party finder matchmaking tool supports role-based filtering and difficulty selection aion2kina, date unknown1 boostroom, date unknown2. do tank: pace based on the healer's capacity, group mobs tightly for aoe, use defensive cooldowns proactively boostroom, date unknown3. healer: use efficient/cheap heals by default, save big cooldowns for genuine danger, track debuffs, communicate pace. dps: focus priority targets, take assigned interrupts, prioritize survival/uptime over raw parse numbers, "clean mechanics and uptime beat big numbers." give a short heads-up on your first run, "please call out the important mechanic," it's considered useful, not a burden. agree on loot rules (roll for valuable items, need = immediate equip, greed = materials) before the first pull. do not start a pull while someone is reading a tooltip, respeccing, or returning from a release. change loot rules mid-run once they're agreed. propose a different fix from everyone after a wipe, agree on one single adjustment instead. chase speed for its own sake as tank, "your job is not to go as fast as possible... without dying." flex/support in 4-player content provides interrupts, crowd control, dispels, and emergency buffs as a fifth utility role. boostroom and similar sites (u4n, mmoexp, expcarry, timesaver.gg, ldcloud) sell currency/boosting/carry services; treat any "buy x" framing as marketing, not neutral advice, though the etiquette content itself is generic mmo best practice. group etiquette tank healer dps roles party finder

title: Open World, Bosses, and PvP Zones
text: open world, bosses, and pvp zones world bosses can spawn inside pvp zones, turning a pve fight into a contested faction brawl. world/field bosses are large creatures that spawn on timers, requiring organized groups or full legions to defeat, dropping rare materials, gear, and crafting components. notably, world bosses can spawn inside pvp zones, forcing contested, chaotic fights against the opposing faction over the kill rather than a controlled pve encounter (confirmed across at least 2 independent write-ups, individual source confidence low). the abyss is the main open-world faction pvp zone, a 3d aerial contested zone, with a 7-hour weekly access limit for free players, doubled by paying membership mmoexp, date unknown1 aion2hub, date unknown2. rifts are temporary cross-faction incursion portals letting players fight in contested or enemy territory; exact frequency/objectives are explicitly stated as unconfirmed by the developer timesaver.gg, date unknown3. a fatigue system reducing xp gains over time is not confirmed, one source vaguely advises watching for it "if implemented," which is speculative language, not a confirmed mechanic. one kr patch-note-derived claim states trash/elite monster loot inside expedition/transcendence instances was removed, pushing rewards to the boss cube instead, single source, unverified for global. no source consulted gave concrete beginner-facing advice for avoiding ganks, such as level-based safe zones, flagging mechanics, or grace periods for new characters. treat this as a real gap in available guidance pending global launch. open world bosses field bosses pvp zones abyss rifts sieges

title: What is worth buying (ranked)
text: what is worth buying (ranked) standard founder's pack first, cosmetics if you like them, consumables only if they save real time. do first: the standard founder's pack ($24.99), if you are committed to playing at launch. timesaver.gg, 20261 it bundles a month of membership you would pay ~$15 for anyway, plus 5-day early access for name reservation and guild founding. worth it for launch-day players. then: cosmetics from the cash shop, bought only if you like the look, since nc and multiple sources agree they carry zero power effect. worth it if you like the look, no downside either way. later / optional: crafting and enhancement consumables in moderation, since these are stated to be earnable free but save time. some editorial pushback notes hardcore players may feel social pressure to buy them anyway even though nominally optional. contested mmorpg.com, 20262 situational, only if it saves you meaningful time. worth buying ranked priority spending

title: Traps and poor value

title: P2W assessment and the KR controversy timeline
text: p2w assessment and the kr controversy timeline no direct power sales globally, but membership indirectly lets paying players buy progression through the market. the mechanism nothing sold directly for cash is stated to increase power globally. the pay-to-win pathway reviewers focus on is indirect: membership gates the market and the kina-to-quna exchange, so a subscribed player can buy kina-denominated gear from other players, buying progression speed without a direct "power item" purchase. contested, how large mmorpg.com, 20261 aion2hub.com, date unknown2 that analysis argues abyss (pvp) gear reportedly cannot be traded, insulating pvp somewhat, though spenders can still gear up faster indirectly via the market. single source, opinion kr/tw controversy timeline nov 19, 2025kr/tw launch40 servers go live; the cash shop sells items that directly boost combat power (combat enhancement scrolls, soul book/soul binding items) using quna, despite prior promises such items would not be sold massivelyop.com, 2025-113. within daysncsoft stock dropsstock reportedly fell more than 15% within a couple of days of launch massivelyop.com, 2025-114. ~15 hours post-launchemergency broadcast and apologyproducer kim nam-joon held an emergency broadcast, admitted the team had been "complacent and unthoughtful," and apologized publicly massivelyop.com, 2025-115. remediationnc pulls the bundlesnc removed the offending cash-shop bundles, gave the gear-enhancing items to all players for free, removed skill-reset costs, and halved cash-shop consumable prices. first 6 weeks~$70 million earned regardlessdespite backlash, aion 2 reportedly earned about $70 million across korea and taiwan, peaking around 2.5 billion krw (about $1.6 million) daily single source, approximate boosting-ground.com, date unknown6. since the controversycosmetics-only stancencsoft producers have publicly stated the shop will sell cosmetics only going forward, "leaning toward skins, mounts, and pets" massivelyop.com, 2025-117. jul 8, 2026global plan formalizes thisnc's official global monetization notice states cosmetics have "no gameplay or combat advantage" and consumables "do not affect gear progression or long-term power." aion2hub.com, date unknown8it also consolidates the dual subscription into one $15/month tier. mmohuts.com, 20269 not confirmed: no source has nc stating, in its own words, that the specific kr-era combat-boosting items are permanently banned from the west. treat "it definitely won't happen again globally" as consistent with nc's current stated plan, not as a guarantee. the overall size of the pay-to-win gap cannot be quantified precisely. the mechanism (subscription gating trade access, plus a cash-to-kina exchange) is confirmed by nc's own plan; how much faster a paying player can gear up is analyst opinion, not an nc-published number. contested pay to win p2w korea taiwan controversy kr-era stock apology

title: Account and social setup mistakes
text: account and social setup mistakes faction/server choice is permanent, and skipping a legion costs you time and mentor perks. picking a faction or server casually. it is effectively permanent and determines who you can play with. confirmed, 2+ sources mein-mmo.de, 2026-091 boostroom.com, 2026-022 not joining a legion (guild). solo players lose time to slow party-finding and missed weekly group clears. it also means more bad pickup groups. single source boostroom.com, 2026-023 avoid: staying solo through choice rather than circumstance, group content and the mentor system both reward being in a legion. mistakes account setup faction legion social

title: Gear and materials mistakes
text: gear and materials mistakes save upgrade materials, skip the pricier abyss scrolls, and don't over-invest in gear you'll replace. selling or discarding gear-upgrade materials (enhancement fragments) instead of saving them. they are scarce once early one-time quests are used up confirmed, 2+ sources mein-mmo.de, 2026-091 boostroom.com, 2026-022. ignoring cheaper "grey" abyss scroll options at weekly vendors that give identical rewards to pricier variants single source boostroom.com, 2026-023. prioritizing low-value daily dungeon rewards (pets, kinah) over enhancement stones needed for gear progression single source boostroom.com, 2026-024. avoid: grabbing the shiny reward over the one that actually feeds your gear pipeline. enhancing gear you will replace soon, wasting scarce upgrade materials on temporary items confirmed, 2+ sources mein-mmo.de, 2026-095 boostroom.com, 2026-026. mistakes gear materials enhancement fragments

title: Systems and scheduling mistakes
text: systems and scheduling mistakes don't spend keys early, skip valuable daily quests, or attempt weekly content before you're ready. spending limited daily keys (for example, shugo fiesta) before reaching max level, which reduces their endgame value. single source boostroom.com, 2026-021 picking the wrong daily quests and missing ones that reward valuable bound keys or fragments. single source boostroom.com, 2026-022 attempting the ascension trial or other high-end weekly content before meeting its real item-level requirement, wasting a limited weekly attempt. single source boostroom.com, 2026-023 avoid: guessing your readiness, check item level and combat power against the requirement first. avoiding the abyss/pvp entirely. non-pvp players can still earn abyss points through supply quests and pve kills, which feed gear and stigma systems single source boostroom.com, 2026-024. playing with no weekly plan at all. repeatedly called out as the single biggest efficiency mistake, since weekly caps and high-value activities matter more than hours logged confirmed, 2+ sources mein-mmo.de, 2026-095 boostroom.com, 2026-026. misusing macros in ways that risk an account flag, stick to the sanctioned two-skill auto-attack macro rather than third-party automation single source. over-grinding materials using outdated kr-original farming routes once global numbers differ single source. mistakes scheduling weekly plan keys abyss ascension

title: Overview and role
text: overview and role templar tanks with a sword or mace and shield, built for threat control and mitigation, not damage. aion 2's dedicated main tank fights in heavy armor with a one handed longsword or mace plus shield; a greatsword sometimes serves as an off-spec backup weapon fextralife, date unknown1 aion2hub, date unknown2. kit size aion2 hub lists 31 active skills and 10 passives single source aion2hub, date unknown3, while a separate guide counts 43 total, 33 active and 9 passive contested gamesolusi, 2026-074. the gap likely comes from counting rank-up versions of the same skill differently, so treat exact skill counts as approximate. role and difficulty built around threat generation, target lockdown, and damage mitigation, not damage output confirmed, multiple guides aion2hub, date unknown5 pvpbank, date unknown6 rated beginner friendly for its durability, but more gear dependent than it looks: mastery points and defensive stats have an outsized effect on performance single source pvpbank, date unknown7 pve and pvp standing kr-era pve (kr/tw meta): dominates dungeon tanking and holds its own solo, but has the lowest damage of the melee/dps classes single source pvpbank, date unknown8 gladiator, assassin, and sorcerer all out-damage it; title: Skill priority
text: skill priority level vicious strike, provoke, and doom shield first to build threat and survive bursts. no single guide gives a definitive numbered skill point leveling order for templar, unlike the more detailed gladiator guides. the list below is assembled from pieces documented across sources; treat it as single source or contested unless noted. core priority do first: chain vicious strike to build and hold aggro, your bread-and-butter threat generator confirmed aion2hub, date unknown1 aoeah, 2025-112. do first: provoke, a single-target taunt used to lock a boss's aggro onto yourself confirmed aion2hub, date unknown3 aoeah, 2025-114. do first: doom shield, a defensive and mitigation cooldown, timed against confirmed incoming burst rather than used on cooldown confirmed aion2hub, date unknown5 aoeah, 2025-116. then: punishment and decisive strike, hard-hitting follow-ups used once a target is locked down. punishment is also described elsewhere as a chargeable aoe with lifesteal in an endgame raid-tank build single source aoeah, 2025-117. then, for mob packs: flash cut (2s cooldown, hits 3 targets, usable while moving) triggers bloodsword slash, which heals for 100% of damage dealt single source pvpbank, date unknown8 aoeah, 2025-119. then, for mob packs: trial (also called falling sword spirits) hits up to 6 targets and reduces their defense by 30% single source pvpbank, date unknown10. then, for mob packs: shield strike grants a shield and heals more the more enemies it hits single source pvpbank, date unknown11. then: capture pulls a target up to 20m in and binds it 2 to 3 seconds, with a 100% bind chance on npcs, good for consolidating scattered mobs before an aoe mitigation skill single source (community synthesis, no direct link) later / optional: fund whichever mitigation or taunt skill you actually have equipped in your active rotation over situational or off-role skills; no source names specific templar skills to ignore early expcarry, date unknown12. passive priority (contested) contested, kr-era, single source a korean forum post about 수호성 (templar) passives gives two competing rankings for five named passives: 격앙 (fury), 모욕의 포효 (roar of insult), 충격 적중 (impact hit), 체력 강화 (hp boost), 단죄의 가호 (judgment's grace), and 철벽 방어 (iron wall defense). by felt or practical value: fury > roar of insult > impact hit, with the rest called not worth investing in by raw combat-power-per-level the order flips: iron wall defense (+0.356k) > impact hit (+0.244k) > hp boost (+0.233k) > judgment's grace (+0.111k) > fury (+0.078k); fury's felt value beats its cp number fmkorea, date unknown13 a second, independent kr guide broadly agrees on prioritizing core damage or defense passives over utility ones, but does not give the same explicit order single source vortexgaming, date unknown14 gap remains: the two rankings above disagree with each other (felt value vs. raw cp-per-level), and neither maps cleanly onto the english passive names used elsewhere on this page, so treat this as a starting point, not a settled order. additional named actives seen in class-overview listings, priority unconfirmed, listed for reference only: ferocious strike, pummel, poach, shield smite, judgment, flash rampage, debilitating smash, warding strike, shield rush, annihilate, defiance, shield of protection, second skin, armor of balance, grapple fextralife, date unknown15. templar skill priority actives passives rotation

title: Daevanion board route
text: daevanion board route boards unlock at levels 12, 20, 30, 40, and four level-45 boards; no confirmed templar-specific route yet. board unlock levels (confirmed, cross-class) confirmed, general mechanic nezekan (lv 12), zikel (lv 20), vaizel (lv 30), triniel (lv 40), and four level-45 advanced boards: ariel, azphel, marchutan, and yustiel fextralife, date unknown1 kr-era, single source a korean gaming-news piece corroborates the same unlock levels and adds stat themes per board daum news, 2025-112 nezekan: combat speed and cooldown reduction zikel: damage amplification and resistance vaizel: critical damage amplification and resistance triniel: multi-hit accuracy and resistance neither source gives a templar-specific route through these boards. gap remains: still no reliable source for a templar-specific daevanion route, which nodes, blue active-skill nodes vs green passive nodes vs stat nodes, or a node-by-node path within the boards above. how the board works daevanion points buy connected nodes on a board; nodes either add flat combat stats or add levels to specific skills. points come from normal character leveling plus daevanion crystals earned through quests and achievements expcarry, date unknown3. strategy: trace the shortest legal path to the node that actually helps your build. treat small connector nodes as a toll, not a destination, and match node choice, skill vs stat, to what your loadout needs most. kr-era reset: the korean client supports resetting the whole board or eligible individual nodes, with individual resets costing 500 kinah in kr, and a dependency rule that a node cannot be removed while another already-acquired node depends on it; cost may differ at global launch expcarry, date unknown4. when to reset: no templar-specific guidance was found; general advice implies resetting once your loadout changes enough that current nodes no longer serve it. templar daevanion board progression
